algeria.record: The Council adopted Japanese–US draft S/2024/500 as resolution 2739 (2024), 12–0–3. Algeria, China and Russia abstained. It extended the Secretary-General’s reporting request under paragraph 10 of resolution 2722 (2024) through 15 January 2025, without granting new authority for military action. Algeria valued monthly reporting on attacks on merchant and commercial vessels to keep the Council informed. It abstained over implementation of resolution 2722 and alleged misuse or misinterpretation of self-defence through attacks on sovereign territory.
